summary: This is a Mol Labs public hypothesis report (P7) proposing that Bax/Bak loss-of-function (or BAX-channel blockade) abolishes FOXO4-DRI senescent-cell killing at least as much as it abolishes navitoclax kill, with each arm requiring ≥20% relative kill loss. The claim is currently a PREDICTION with no experimental data run; all supporting evidence is drawn from published literature. The document is classified as NEGATIVE status, indicating the epistasis result is UNKNOWN and the experiment has NOT been run.

content_blocks.title: Document Metadata and Policy
content_blocks.content: Public report only (PUBLIC_REPORT_ONLY). Report date: 2026-09-25. STATUS_LABEL: NEGATIVE. Risk class: research-discussion. Polarity: negative. Note: Identical science to openlabs.md; no sequence, analog list, or unpublished construct; no mol_ keys. Execution status: NOT_RUN. FTO status: UNKNOWN. Related prior: P6 (not proof of Bax/Bak epistasis).

content_blocks.title: Central Claim (P7)
content_blocks.content: On a matched senescent culture, Bax/Bak loss-of-function (or BAX-channel blockade) abolishes FOXO4-DRI senescent-cell kill at least as much as it abolishes navitoclax kill. Pre-registered relative kill loss_FOXO4 ≥ relative kill loss_navitoclax, with each arm showing a pre-registered ≥20% relative kill loss vs the same senolytic on control genotype/vehicle. This is a PREDICTION — no experimental data has been generated.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale and Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: FOXO4-DRI enters via FOXO4–p53 axis; navitoclax enters via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w. Both may still require Bax/Bak MOMP (mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization) for execution. Endothelial FOXO4-DRI work frames a p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 cascade — Bcl-2-family nodes can sit downstream without proving Bax/Bak necessity. Humanin–Bax MOMP block is a mechanism prior for pharmacologic BAX-channel interference, not a FOXO4-DRI epistasis result. Key assumption: if FOXO4-DRI still needs Bax/Bak, distinct entry does not spare MOMP-gated interference; ≥ equal abolish is stronger than 'both use mitochondria.'

content_blocks.title: Prior Art / Literature Evidence
content_blocks.content:
1. PMID 28340339 / DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2017.02.031 / PMC5556182 — FOXO4-DRI perturbs FOXO4–p53 → senescent-cell apoptosis (Baar 2017); not Bcl-xL occupancy; no Bax/Bak LOF arm.
2. PMID 41625068 / DOI 10.3389/fbioe.2025.1729166 / PMC12852416 — endothelial FOXO4-DRI framed via p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 (2025); not Bax/Bak DKO epistasis.
3. PMID 26711051 / DOI 10.1111/acel.12445 / PMC4854923 — navitoclax senolytic via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w; cell-type restricted (Zhu 2016).
4. PMID 12732850 / DOI 10.1038/nature01627 — humanin binds Bax; blocks mitochondrial translocation/cytochrome c release (Guo 2003) — MOMP-block prior, not FOXO4-DRI epistasis.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Status: Measured vs. Claimed
content_blocks.content:
Baseline claimed: Distinct FOXO4–p53 entry means FOXO4-DRI SC kill need not share Bax/Bak necessity with navitoclax, or P6's shared-MOMP caveat already settles the epistasis.
Baseline measured: FOXO4–p53 entry LITERATURE (PMID 28340339). Downstream BCL-2/caspase framing LITERATURE without Bax/Bak LOF (PMID 41625068). Navitoclax Bcl-2-family senolytic LITERATURE (PMID 26711051). HN–Bax MOMP block LITERATURE as mechanism prior (PMID 12732850). FOXO4-DRI∩Bax/Bak knockout/epistasis soft-complete 0; FOXO4-DRI∩(cytochrome c|MOMP) soft-complete 0; matched Bax/Bak LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax UNKNOWN. ≥ equal abolish (loss_FOXO4 ≥ loss_nav; each ≥20% relative) PREDICTION. P6 does not already prove this epistasis.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat P6 as proving P7 — P6 left Bax epistasis UNKNOWN and used HN equal-blunt as a separate PREDICTION; it did not run Bax/Bak LOF.
2. BCL-2 cascade language ≠ Bax requirement — PMID 41625068 is not a Bax/Bak LOF kill of FOXO4-DRI.
3. ≥ equal abolish is stronger than shared mitochondrial involvement — FOXO4-DRI could keep partial Bax-independent death routes; navitoclax-insensitive SC types confound matched culture choice.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: On the pre-registered matched panel, FOXO4-DRI kill largely survives Bax/Bak LOF/BAX-channel block while navitoclax kill is abolished, OR relative kill loss_FOXO4 is below relative kill loss_navitoclax outside the pre-registered ≥ equal band — pathway-sparing/Bax-independent FOXO4-DRI execution survives.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Assay Design (Method)
content_blocks.content: Method type: propose-assay. Required elements: (1) Lock one senescent system sensitive to both senolytics; (2) Bax/Bak LOF vs BAX-channel-block tool; (3) Viability + cytochrome-c readout. Readout: relative kill loss under Bax/Bak LOF or BAX-channel block for each senolytic vs control. Pre-registration required before claiming ≥ equal abolish. Do not treat P6 as proof; no dosing to be invented.

Central claim: Bax/Bak LOF or BAX-channel blockade abolishes FOXO4-DRI senescent-cell kill ≥ navitoclax kill, with each arm requiring ≥20% relative kill loss vs control.

FOXO4-DRI mechanism enters via FOXO4–p53 axis (PMID 28340339, Baar 2017); navitoclax via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w (PMID 26711051, Zhu 2016) — distinct upstream entries but potentially shared MOMP execution.
Matched Bax/Bak LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax epistasis panel: soft-complete 0 — UNKNOWN; no dedicated experiment found in literature.
FOXO4-DRI∩Bax/Bak knockout/epistasis: soft-complete 0. FOXO4-DRI∩(cytochrome c|MOMP): soft-complete 0.
Humanin–Bax MOMP block (PMID 12732850, Guo 2003) provides mechanism prior for BAX-channel tools but is NOT a FOXO4-DRI epistasis result.
Endothelial FOXO4-DRI p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 framing (PMID 41625068, 2025) does not constitute Bax/Bak LOF epistasis evidence.
P6 did not run Bax/Bak LOF and does not prove P7 epistasis — explicitly flagged as a critical limitation.
Estimated time to refute: 4 weeks; kill cost tier: 1 (low cost); IP class: momp-execution-gate; vault hold: no.
Refutation condition: FOXO4-DRI kill survives Bax/Bak LOF while navitoclax kill is abolished, or kill loss_FOXO4 < kill loss_navitoclax outside pre-registered ≥ equal band.
